Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.clients

Class ClientAdminController

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.clients.ClientAdminController
All Implemented Interfaces:
ClientsApi
@RestController public class ClientAdminController extends Object implements ClientsApi
Administration of the registered clients, as the contract apis/auth-server/rest-server/auth-server-api-v1.yaml describes it through the generated ClientsApi. Secrets are never returned, except once when a confidential client is created or its secret is rotated. Failures are answered as problem details by ClientExceptionHandler.
